author: CSP_News
name: Colorado State Patrol
text:
If you are driving down the road and observe a runaway semi-truck coming towards you in your rearview mirrors, stay calm and attempt to merge to the left, as all runaway truck ramps in Colorado are on the right shoulder. This will allow the truck to safely enter the ramp without colliding with anyone. This video was taken on westbound I-70 coming down Eisenhower Pass a few days ago, and highlights the importance of using these runaway truck ramps!
